hints.title: Which sticks should be joined first?
hints.body: A stick that is joined early contributes its length to every later join. Should a long stick or a short stick be involved in more joins?

hints.title: Always take the two shortest
hints.body: The optimal strategy is a Huffman-style merge: repeatedly join the two shortest sticks and put the combined stick back into the collection.

hints.title: Use a min-heap
hints.body: A sorted array makes finding the two shortest easy, but inserting the combined stick is expensive. A min-heap gives both operations in logarithmic time.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
heap = min-heap of sticks
total = 0
while heap has more than one element:
    first = heap.pop()
    second = heap.pop()
    combined = first + second
    total += combined
    heap.push(combined)
return total
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. A single stick returns zero without entering the loop.
